segments.text: Airflow in a biological safety cabinet, or BSC, can be interrupted, altered, and changed
segments.zh: 生物安全柜（BSC）内的气流可能会被中断、改变和扰乱，

segments.text: by many different factors.
segments.zh: 原因有许多不同的因素。

segments.text: These interruptions can lead to potential exposures and or product contamination.
segments.zh: 这些干扰可能导致潜在的暴露和／或样品污染。

segments.text: This is a smoke generator.
segments.zh: 这是一台烟雾发生器。

segments.text: It is used to demonstrate how airflow is affected by operations inside and around
segments.zh: 它用来演示生物安全柜内部及周围的操作如何影响

segments.text: a BSC.
segments.zh: 气流。

segments.text: But first, let's look at what proper airflow looks like.
segments.zh: 不过首先，我们来看看正确的气流是什么样的。

segments.text: For proper containment, air is drawn into the cabinet at the opening and then down into the
segments.zh: 为了实现正确的防护，空气在柜体开口处被吸入，然后向下流入

segments.text: front grille.
segments.zh: 前格栅。

segments.text: Together, the sash and inward flowing air provide an air curtain or barrier that is intended
segments.zh: 前窗和向内流动的空气共同形成一道气帘或屏障，用于

segments.text: to keep cabinet air and room air separate from one another.
segments.zh: 使柜内空气和室内空气彼此隔开。

segments.text: To protect the work product, the cabinet's downward air is cleaned by a high-efficiency
segments.zh: 为了保护工作样品，柜内向下的气流会经过柜内的高效

segments.text: filter within the cabinet.
segments.zh: 过滤器净化。

segments.text: Upon reaching the work surface, roughly half of the downflow air moves toward the front
segments.zh: 到达工作台面时，大约一半的下降气流流向前

segments.text: grille and the other half moves toward the back grille.
segments.zh: 格栅，另一半流向后格栅。

segments.text: The physical location of the BSC can affect the airflow as well.
segments.zh: 生物安全柜摆放的物理位置也会影响气流。

segments.text: Placing a BSC too close to a doorway can cause the air to be drawn out of the BSC when
segments.zh: 生物安全柜离门口太近，开门时会导致空气被

segments.text: a door is open.
segments.zh: 从安全柜中抽出来。

segments.text: Placing a BSC too close to an HVAC supply vent can also interfere with the BSC containment.
segments.zh: 生物安全柜离暖通空调送风口太近，也会干扰安全柜的防护性能。

segments.text: Proper sash height is critical because when the sash is kept at the proper height, the
segments.zh: 正确的前窗高度至关重要，因为前窗保持在正确高度时，

segments.text: appropriate inward airflow can be maintained.
segments.zh: 才能维持适当的向内气流。

segments.text: The proper sash height is designated in the BSC operation manual and should be clearly
segments.zh: 正确的前窗高度在生物安全柜操作手册中有规定，并且应在安全柜上

segments.text: indicated on the BSC.
segments.zh: 清楚标明。

segments.text: The performance at the BSC at the declared sash height is actually part of the cabinet
segments.zh: 生物安全柜在标定前窗高度下的性能，实际上是安全柜

segments.text: certification process.
segments.zh: 认证过程的一部分。

segments.text: If the sash is too low, inward air velocity will increase at the opening, which can cause
segments.zh: 如果前窗太低，开口处的向内风速会增大，这可能导致

segments.text: turbulence and potential contamination inside the cabinet.
segments.zh: 柜内产生湍流和潜在污染。

segments.text: If the sash is set too high, an alarm will sound.
segments.zh: 如果前窗设得太高，就会响起报警。

segments.text: This indicates the inward air velocity may slow down to a point that it cannot provide
segments.zh: 这表明向内风速可能会降低到无法在前窗开口处

segments.text: and maintain containment at the sash opening.
segments.zh: 提供并维持防护的程度。

segments.text: This could cause contaminated air to leak out of the cabinet or room air to enter the BSC
segments.zh: 这可能导致被污染的空气从柜内泄漏出来，或者室内空气进入生物安全柜

segments.text: opening, mix with the downflow air, and potentially contaminate the work product.
segments.zh: 开口，与下降气流混合，从而可能污染工作样品。

segments.text: Even when the sash height is correct, the air barrier at the opening is fragile, approximately
segments.zh: 即使前窗高度正确，开口处的气流屏障也很脆弱，大约是

segments.text: 100 feet per minute, or 1 mile per hour.
segments.zh: 每分钟 100 英尺，也就是每小时 1 英里。

segments.text: It can be easily disrupted.
segments.zh: 它很容易被扰乱。

segments.text: Something as simple as the way you withdraw your arms or a person walking too close to
segments.zh: 就连抽出手臂的方式，或者有人在离安全柜太近的地方走过这样简单的事情，

segments.text: the cabinet can pull air and potential contaminants out of the cabinet and into the breathing
segments.zh: 都可能把空气和潜在的污染物从柜内拉出来，进入在生物安全柜前工作人员的呼吸

segments.text: zone of the person working in the BSC.
segments.zh: 区。

segments.text: One common mistake is overloading the inside of the BSC with too much equipment and or
segments.zh: 一个常见的错误是在生物安全柜内放了过多的设备和／或

segments.text: supplies, or covering the front or rear grills.
segments.zh: 物品，或者遮挡了前格栅或后格栅。

segments.text: Another way to disrupt airflow is by using a flame inside the cabinet.
segments.zh: 另一种扰乱气流的情况是在柜内使用明火。

segments.text: This is not a good idea for two reasons.
segments.zh: 这样做不好，原因有两个。

segments.text: One, the heat from the flame can cause air currents inside the BSC and interfere with
segments.zh: 第一，火焰产生的热量会在生物安全柜内形成气流，干扰

segments.text: proper airflow.
segments.zh: 正常的气流。

segments.text: And two, flames are a fire hazard and can damage the HEPA filter.
segments.zh: 第二，明火有火灾危险，还可能损坏 HEPA 过滤器。

segments.text: For these reasons, flames should not be used inside a BSC.
segments.zh: 基于这些原因，不应在生物安全柜内使用明火。
